names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 11 iunie, «Sfântul Apostol Barnaba».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Ιουνίου, «Άγιοι Βαρθολομαίος και Βαρνάβας», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 11. јун ст. ст., „Свети Варнава апостол“ — Свети is not a rank and апостол is the `apostle` this corpus puts in `types`, so both come off and the bare personal name is the whole of the form. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`, so this is the first holder, although `barnabas-of-the-vetluga` stands on this same menologion day in another calendar and will fold onto this string when somebody writes his Serbian form.

Read out of the name link behind the calendar's line for 11 июня ст. ст., name page 358, «Святой Варнава, апостол от 70-ти». The line gives the name in the genitive («Варнавы»); the rank «апостол от 70-ти» is not stored with the form.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 июня ст. ст. — «Апостолов Варфоломея и Варнавы (I)»

attestations.note: The day heads the two apostles of the day together in one line and gives only the century, «(I)»; it offers no year, no place and no account of his end. The name link behind «Варнавы» is name page 358, «Святой Варнава, апостол от 70-ти», which is where the stored `ru` form is read from: the line itself declines the name and the link adds the rank, and neither the declension nor the rank is stored. The day page's «Молитвы» block — which is where this calendar keeps its hymns, never on a life page — prints five, and three of them are his: a common of the apostles, a troparion sung to the two apostles of the day together which names and addresses him, and a kontakion proper to him. The two «Кондак апостола Варфоломея» are the other apostle's and were left. His Russian life page id358 was linked and NOT READ: this folder already carries a long life off doxologia.ro, saint.gr and the Охридски пролог, and this upgrade adds a day, a name form and the hymns only. Not checked: azbyka.ru.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 11 iunie — «Sfântul Apostol Barnaba»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιοι Βαρθολομαίος και Βαρνάβας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and gives no years. It is plainly the same man: the Jewish Levite of Cyprus, also called Joses, chief co-worker of the apostle Paul, stoned and then burnt at Salamis in Cyprus, whose relics Mark gathered into a cave. The page keeps him on the same day as the apostle Bartholomew and prints one apolytikion naming them both. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 24.06.2026 (11. јун ст. ст.) — „Свети Варнава апостол“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. A THIRD BOOK ON A TWELVE-KILOBYTE LIFE, AND IT ADDS TWO THINGS AND A NAME. Everything else in the entry is already here at length: Cyprus and the rich parents, the schooling with Saul under Gamaliel, the name Joseph changed by the apostles to Barnabas, his introducing Saul to the apostles after the conversion, the preaching with Paul and Mark at Antioch and elsewhere, the suffering on Cyprus, the burial by Mark at the western gate of Salamis with the Gospel of Matthew on his breast which he had copied with his own hand, the grave unknown for centuries, the place called «the place of health», the appearance to archbishop Anthimus of Cyprus, the emperor Zeno, the Council, the patriarch of Antioch’s claim, and the autocephaly that came of it. **A reader who finds nothing new should say so.** WHAT IS NEW: that his parents were **of the tribe of Levi**, which no page read for this folder says; that the apostle appeared to Anthimus **three times in three nights**, where the earlier account has one vision; and that the ambitious patriarch of Antioch is **named, Peter**, where the earlier account calls him only the patriarch of Antioch. The Prologue also glosses the new name in its own words, „Сином Утехе“, Son of Consolation, «since he knew extraordinarily well how to comfort human souls». NO `dates`, AND BOTH BOOKS AGREE IN GIVING NONE. The folder holds `dates: null` and this entry prints no year for anything in his life; the emperor Zeno and the Council are the only fixed points and they belong to the finding of the relics four centuries after him. **The appended paragraph carries no four-digit year at all**, deliberately: this folder has neither a birth nor a death, so `date-audit`’s `stated` reads its prose for both. Measured: `stated` 153, unmoved. `types` untouched at `apostle`, corroborated by апостол and by „Један од Седамдесеторице“ — and **the book is explicit that he is of the Seventy and not of the Twelve**, which this corpus’s single `apostle` type does not distinguish; said here because the day’s other entry opens «one of the twelve great apostles» and the two folders carry the identical `types`. `related` UNTOUCHED: `bartholomew-the-apostle`, `paul-the-apostle`, `mark-the-evangelist` and `aristobulus-of-britain` are all four already there, and the entry names nobody else who has a folder — Gamaliel’s folder exists and the existing prose already names him without a row, which `related-floor.test.mjs` does not match, and a teacher shared with Saul is a schooling and not a martyrdom or a kinship; the patriarch Peter is the adversary of the story. No `locations`. THE FORM IS FREE: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Варнава», although the corpus keeps a Barnabas of the Vetluga on this same menologion day. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

hymns.text: Sfinţilor Apostoli rugaţi pe milostivul Dumnezeu ca să dea iertare de greşeli sufletelor noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Apostol Barnaba, Glasul 3

english.text: Holy apostles, entreat the merciful God to grant our souls forgiveness of offences.

hymns.text: Θεία ὄργανα, τοῦ Παρακλήτου, καὶ ἐκφάντορες, τοῦ Θεοῦ Λόγου, ἀνεδείχθητε θεόπται Ἀπόστολοι, Βαρθολομαῖε τῶν Δώδεκα σύσκηνε, καὶ Βαρνάβα ὡς υἱὸς παρακλήσεως. Ἀλλὰ αἰτήσασθε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν πανεύφημοι, δωρήσασθαι ἠμὶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος γ', Θείας πίστεως — the first of two apolytikia on the page of «Άγιοι Βαρθολομαίος και Βαρνάβας», and the one that names them both; the second is a common of apostles, and the page's kontakion names Bartholomew alone

english.text: You were shown to be divine instruments of the Paraclete and revealers of the Word of God, O apostles who beheld God — Bartholomew, tent-fellow of the Twelve, and Barnabas, as a son of consolation. All-praised ones, ask Christ our God to grant us his great mercy.

hymns.text: Апостоли святии,/ молите Милостиваго Бога,/ да прегрешений оставление// подаст душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 июня ст. ст. — «Тропарь апостолов»

english.text: O holy apostles, pray to the merciful God, that he may grant unto our souls the remission of our transgressions.

hymns.text: Язык огнедохновен в силе Духа приемше,/ во плоти пришедшее Слово проповедаете всюду,/ Егоже ради ов во главу усечен,/ ов же камением побиен,/ и есте апостольскому лику украшение,/ Варфоломее и Варнаво,/ темже память вашу почитаем и просим:/ молите Христа Бога подати нам грехов оставление.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 июня ст. ст. — «Ин тропарь апостолов Варфоломея и Варнавы»

english.text: Having received a tongue of fiery breath in the power of the Spirit, ye preach everywhere the Word that came in the flesh, for whose sake the one of you was beheaded and the other stoned with stones. Ye are the adornment of the apostolic choir, O Bartholomew and Barnabas; therefore do we honour your memory, and we ask: pray to Christ God to grant us the remission of our sins.

hymns.text: Господень был еси всеистинный служитель,/ апостолов же явился еси седмидесятих первый,/ озарил еси и с Павлом проповедь твою,/ всем возвещаяй Христа Спаса,/ сего ради песнопении// Божественную память твою, Варнаво, совершаем.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 июня ст. ст. — «Кондак апостола Варнавы»

english.text: Thou wast the Lord's wholly true servant, and thou didst appear as the first of the seventy apostles; together with Paul thou didst make thy preaching shine out, proclaiming Christ the Saviour unto all. Therefore with hymns do we keep thy divine memory, O Barnabas.
